explanation: The first model, launched in Japan in 1979, had two headphone sockets so friends could listen together. Philips had introduced the compact cassette itself in 1963.

claims.text: Sony launched the Walkman portable cassette player.
The Walkman was not made by Panasonic, Philips or Toshiba.
The first Walkman model went on sale in Japan in 1979 and had two headphone sockets.
Philips introduced the compact cassette in 1963.
